name: The First-Game Walkthrough
note: KP-18 (2026-11-06): the walkthrough that sat unused named fixed cells on a new puzzle and moved on with a Next button. These break the parts a player meets: when it is offered, when a step counts as done, the killer order, and leaving it.

mutations.name: the walkthrough is offered every time
mutations.why: Asked at every new game until a game is finished, a new player would see the same question again and again.
mutations.expectFailure: the second new game offered the walkthrough again

mutations.name: players who have played are offered it too
mutations.why: Everyone updating from an older version would be asked about a first game they had long since played.
mutations.expectFailure: a player with games played was offered

mutations.name: any digit in the glowing cell moves on
mutations.why: The step teaches that only one digit fits; moving on after a wrong one teaches the opposite.
mutations.expectFailure: a wrong digit in the glowing cell moved the walkthrough on

mutations.name: a new step sees the last step's cell
mutations.why: Two guards stop it: the target is kept with the step that picked it, and nothing moves on before the step has picked its own cell. Either alone holds (gate 2-35 checks each line); taken out together, the cage step's cell — already filled — ends the rule of 45 at once, as it did once on screen.

mutations.name: the killer rules skip the offer
mutations.why: The first killer starts from the rules card; started straight from there, the killer walkthrough is never offered.
mutations.expectFailure: the first killer game did not offer the killer walkthrough

mutations.name: closing the walkthrough leaves the game
mutations.why: The walkthrough is played on a real board; the old one went back Home and the half-played game counted as given up.
mutations.expectFailure: closing the walkthrough left the game

mutations.name: back during the walkthrough leaves the game
mutations.why: The same as the close button, by the back key.
mutations.expectFailure: back during the walkthrough left the game
